top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before June.
At mile 60 of 101, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 101 miles.
Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic. Train it until it feels boring.
At Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,517ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
101 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 101 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.weather: June in Royal Town of Pekan, Pahang, Malaysia — Tropical monsoon climate with warm, humid conditions ideal for road cycling. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic’s 101 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Gran Fondo Pekan / Pekan Classic rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Durability, and Road Specific to prepare you for 101 miles of mixed terrain in Royal Town of Pekan, Pahang, Malaysia.
